units.source_text: “多亏现今人都变成了傻瓜，狗也就能轻松地活着。

en.t: Thanks to people nowadays all turning into fools, dogs can live easily too.

units.source_text: 死一两个人，有的狗连‘汪’都不叫一声呢。

en.t: Even if one or two people die, some dogs will not so much as bark once.

units.source_text: 你说像这样的狗没必要杀？”

en.t: Are you saying there is no need to kill a dog like that?
